title: This is not the loud timer I was looking for! Its small
text:
This is not the loud timer I was looking for! Its small. I have only had this about one week and it still works

But I have to say what some of the others said here.

The numbers are SMALL, and too close together...Lucky I have long thin fingers..

I and My Husband could not figure out how to set the Clock! I wanted to throw it in the trash. but I handed it to one of my Grandkids that were here, and even though it took him some time, he got it right..He didn't think it was a big deal!! but it is! I hope the battery lasts a long time..it did come with a battery, but it looks like a cheap one..I should have put in one of my own.

I do not put stuff on my Frig, but this is on the side of it...

When I go to stop the timer or set it, it starts to move back/down, cause the back is uneven. You have to put the little feld sticky things on the back bottom, and that solved that problem..

What I did expect after reading about this? Was to have a loud Kitchen timer, as that is what I was looking for..

I bought this as a timer for my Kitchen..My new stove's timer is very soft..But this timer so far has been dependable, BUT NOT SO LOUD..

If I'm in the another room, (and I have a open floor plan), this timer CANNOT BE HEARD , isn't that the whole idea of a kitchen timer??..

If this was next to my bed the timer would be loud enough..Maybe this should not be advertized as a kitchen timer!

As a Bedroom clock, and alarm, how can you depend on it if the battery goes bad, cause its so confusing how to get the clock to work.If I traveled and used this, and the battery went out, this would be thrown out, very frustrating....

There is another timer in Amazon that has larger numbers,Is less then half this price, and seems to work like this one does.The only reason I didn't buy it was because It didn't come from Amazon, and I already was ordering a few idems...

Bed Bath & beyond had kitchen timers, but nobody that worked there knew if they where going to be loud, or it just made a ding!

I don't think this is worth the money, I'm disapointed..

Now I wonder why I'm keeping it??..

The positive is, it looks good, and it does work.....

I would not buy this again, after owning it..

product_metadata.title: CDN Big-Digit Digital Timer/Clock
features: Combination timer and clock; extra-loud alarm; oversized digital display
Made from brushed stainless steel for a sleek, contemporary look
Counts down 24 hours by seconds, minutes, and hours; last count auto recall
description: CDN Big Digit Digital Timer/Clock with Loud alarm

With its handsome brushed stainless steel face and sleek digital styling, this is one timekeeper thats equally at home in kitchen or bedroom. Whether employed as a timer or as a bedside clock, it features an extra-loud alarm to rouse heavy sleepers or alert cooks in the next room, and the extra-large, big-digit display ensures that its easy to both see and set. Used to time baking, homework, games, or chores, it counts off 24 hours by second, minute or hour, calculates both down and up, and features an automatic recall of the last countdown. A recessed stand adds to the minimalist look. This clock is covered by a five-year limited warranty; it runs off a single AAA battery, which is included with purchase.
